    me.mrCookieSlime.Slimefun.Objects.SlimefunItem.interfaces.InventoryBlock

  • Deprecated Classes 
    Class and Description
    io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.groups.FlexItemGroup
    Addon-defined custom guide screens are deprecated in this fork. The guide only shows categories and plain item lists; an addon FlexItemGroup is rendered as a plain item list (its custom open is ignored) and logs a warning. Contribute categories and items instead, and use a GuideWidget button for genuinely functional screens.
    io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils.LoreBuilder
    Building lore in code is exactly what the unified lore system replaces. Stat/usage lines (energy, speed, material, hunger, range, radioactivity, the RIGHT/CROUCH hints) belong in languages/en/items.yml as stats/usage block entries, where they are localizable and follow the fixed Type/Description/Stats/Usage structure. Do not add new LoreBuilder calls; migrate existing ones into the item's en/items.yml entry.
  • Deprecated Methods 
    Method and Description
    io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.SlimefunItem.addOfficialWikipage(String)
    the wiki URL shown in-game is now derived uniformly from the item's addon and id (see WikiLinks.urlFor); this no longer has any effect on that URL.
    me.mrCookieSlime.Slimefun.Objects.SlimefunItem.interfaces.InventoryBlock.createPreset(SlimefunItem, Consumer<BlockMenuPreset>)
    Leaves the created preset with neither a declared header item nor an explicit title colour, so its GUI title silently falls back to gray unless the (accidental) name-matching heuristic happens to find one. Use InventoryBlock.createPreset(SlimefunItem, String, int, Consumer) if this menu has a decorative slot repeating the item's own name, or InventoryBlock.createPreset(SlimefunItem, String, ChatColor, Consumer) to explicitly declare that it does not and choose the title colour instead.
    me.mrCookieSlime.Slimefun.Objects.SlimefunItem.interfaces.InventoryBlock.createPreset(SlimefunItem, String, Consumer<BlockMenuPreset>)
    See InventoryBlock.createPreset(SlimefunItem, Consumer).
